name: Tuberculosis
fact: Mycobacterium tuberculosis has a waxy mycolic acid cell wall that lets it survive inside lung macrophages.

name: Leprosy
symptoms: Complete loss of pain in skin lesions
fact: Mycobacterium leprae prefers cooler body tissues like skin and peripheral nerves and has an incubation period of years.

name: Anthrax
fact: Bacillus anthracis forms tough endospores that can remain dormant in soil for decades.

name: Lyme disease
symptoms: Migratory joint pain in the knees
fact: The classic erythema migrans rash spreads outward from the site of an Ixodes tick bite.

name: Rocky Mountain spotted fever
symptoms: Sudden high fever and severe headache
Pinpoint rash starting on wrists and ankles
Rash spreading to palms and soles
fact: Rickettsia rickettsii is an obligate intracellular bacterium that infects the endothelial cells lining blood vessels.

name: Plague
symptoms: History of rodent or flea exposure
Darkening tissue on fingers and toes
fact: Yersinia pestis caused the 14th-century Black Death pandemic and is today treatable with antibiotics.

name: Cholera
symptoms: Sudden onset of nausea and vomiting
Rapid heart rate and dry mouth
Severe leg cramps from electrolyte loss
fact: Vibrio cholerae secretes a toxin that locks intestinal chloride channels open, pouring water into the gut lumen.

name: Tetanus
symptoms: History of a deep puncture wound
Stiffness in neck and abdominal muscles
Rigidly clenched jaw and fixed grin
fact: Tetanospasmin neurotoxin blocks inhibitory neurotransmitters in the spinal cord, causing continuous muscle contraction.

name: Botulism
fact: Botulinum toxin prevents acetylcholine release at neuromuscular junctions, causing flaccid paralysis.

name: Syphilis
symptoms: Copper-colored rash on palms and soles
Patchy hair loss in the second stage
fact: Treponema pallidum is a corkscrew-shaped spirochete bacterium known in medicine as 'the great imitator'.

name: Gonorrhea
symptoms: Swelling and tenderness at the urethra
Thick purulent urethral or cervical discharge
fact: Neisseria gonorrhoeae is a coffee-bean-shaped Gram-negative diplococcus that uses pili to attach to mucosal surfaces.

name: Legionnaires' disease
symptoms: High fever, chills, and muscle aches
Dry cough progressing to chest pain
Pneumonia after mist from cooling towers
fact: Legionella pneumophila thrives inside freshwater amoebae in warm building plumbing and cooling systems.

name: Listeriosis
symptoms: Diarrhea after eating soft cheese or meats
Severe risk in pregnancy or newborns
Stiff neck, headache, and loss of balance
fact: Listeria monocytogenes can multiply at refrigerator temperatures (4 °C) and propel itself between cells using actin tails.

name: Typhoid fever
symptoms: Abnormally slow pulse for the high fever
Faint salmon-pink 'rose spots' on the trunk
fact: Salmonella enterica serovar Typhi can persist chronically in the gallbladder of asymptomatic carriers.

name: Shigellosis
symptoms: Spread by tiny fecal-oral infectious dose
Shallow mucosal ulcers in the colon
Small-volume stools with blood and mucus
fact: As few as 10 to 100 Shigella bacteria can cause infection because they resist stomach acid.

name: Scarlet fever
symptoms: Coarse red 'sandpaper' rash on the trunk
fact: Streptococcus pyogenes strains carrying a bacteriophage produce erythrogenic toxin, causing the sandpaper rash.

name: Pneumococcal pneumonia
symptoms: Abrupt high fever and shaking chills
Sharp chest pain worse on deep breath
Dense consolidation of one lung lobe
fact: Streptococcus pneumoniae is the most common cause of community-acquired bacterial pneumonia.

name: C. diff colitis
fact: Broad-spectrum antibiotics wipe out normal gut flora, allowing spore-forming C. difficile to overgrow.

name: Malaria
symptoms: Anemia from red blood cell destruction
Recent travel to a tropical region
Cyclical shaking chills and fever every 48h
fact: Synchronized bursting of infected red blood cells every 48 or 72 hours triggers the periodic fever paroxysms.

name: African sleeping sickness
symptoms: Painful skin sore after a fly bite
Swollen lymph nodes at back of neck
fact: Trypanosoma brucei constantly switches its surface glycoprotein coat to evade the host immune system.

name: Toxoplasmosis
symptoms: Mild flu-like fatigue and body aches
Exposure to cat litter or undercooked meat
Ring-enhancing brain lesions in weak immunity
fact: Domestic and wild felids are the only definitive hosts in which Toxoplasma gondii can reproduce sexually.

name: Primary amoebic meningoencephalitis
symptoms: Sudden severe frontal headache and fever
Altered sense of smell and taste
Rapidly fatal brain inflammation via nose
fact: Naegleria fowleri enters through the nasal passages during freshwater diving and travels along the olfactory nerve.

name: Dengue fever
symptoms: Low platelet count and easy bruising
Flushed skin rash after fever drops
fact: Secondary infection with a different viral serotype increases the risk of severe hemorrhagic complications.

name: Yellow fever
symptoms: Brief remission followed by toxic relapse
Deep jaundice after tropical mosquito bite
fact: Waiter Walter Reed and Carlos Finlay proved that Aedes aegypti mosquitoes transmit the virus.

name: Zika virus disease
symptoms: Joint pain in hands and feet
fact: First identified in Uganda's Zika Forest in 1947, the virus can cross the placental barrier to infect fetal neural progenitors.

name: Ascariasis
symptoms: Dry cough and wheezing during larval phase
fact: Swallowed Ascaris larvae hatch in the gut, migrate through the bloodstream to the lungs, and are coughed up and swallowed again.

name: Pinworm infection
symptoms: Tiny white worms detected by tape test
fact: Gravid female worms migrate out of the anus at night to lay thousands of microscopic eggs on perianal skin.

name: Hookworm infection
symptoms: Itchy rash on feet after walking barefoot
Worms attach to small intestine mucosa
Severe iron-deficiency anemia from blood loss
fact: Soil-dwelling filariform larvae penetrate directly through the skin of bare feet and feed on intestinal blood.

name: Trichinosis
symptoms: Eating undercooked pork or wild game
Swelling around eyes and painful muscles
fact: Trichinella larvae encyst inside striated skeletal muscle cells, turning them into specialized 'nurse cells'.

name: Schistosomiasis
symptoms: Itchy rash after wading in freshwater
Abdominal pain and bloody stool or urine
fact: Fork-tailed cercariae released by freshwater snails penetrate human skin in seconds.

name: Cysticercosis
symptoms: Calcified larval cysts visible on brain CT
fact: Eating undercooked pork causes intestinal tapeworms, whereas ingesting Taenia solium eggs causes tissue cysts in the brain.

name: Hydatid disease
symptoms: Close contact with sheepdogs and livestock
fact: Dogs are the definitive host and sheep are the intermediate host for this tiny 5-mm tapeworm.

name: Scabies
symptoms: Lesions between fingers and on wrists
Tiny wavy burrow lines in the epidermis
fact: Microscopic Sarcoptes scabiei mites tunnel into the upper layer of the skin to lay their eggs.

name: River blindness
symptoms: Bites from blackflies near fast rivers
fact: Satoshi Omura and William Campbell won the 2015 Nobel Prize for discovering ivermectin, which prevents this disease.

name: Measles
symptoms: Cough, runny nose, and red eyes
Red blotchy rash starting at the hairline
Tiny white spots inside cheek (Koplik spots)
fact: One of the most contagious human viruses known, with a basic reproduction number (R0) of 12 to 18.

name: Chickenpox
symptoms: Intensely itchy red spots on trunk and face
Fluid blisters ('dewdrops on a rose petal')
Spots, blisters, and scabs all at once
fact: After recovery, the virus stays dormant in sensory nerve ganglia and can reactivate decades later as shingles.

name: Mumps
symptoms: Muscle aches and loss of appetite
Pain when chewing or swallowing sour foods
fact: Before routine MMR vaccination, this paramyxovirus was a leading cause of viral meningitis and acquired deafness in children.

name: Influenza
symptoms: Dry hacking cough and sore throat
fact: Segmented RNA genomes allow antigenic shift and drift, which is why seasonal vaccines are updated annually.

name: COVID-19
symptoms: Binds ACE2 receptors on airway cells
Sudden loss of smell and taste (anosmia)
fact: The viral spike glycoprotein binds to the host cell's angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) receptor.

name: Rabies
symptoms: Fever and tingling at a healed bite wound
Virus travels up peripheral nerves to brain
Painful throat spasms at the sight of water
fact: Nearly 100% fatal once neurological symptoms appear, yet preventable with prompt post-exposure vaccination.

name: Polio
fact: The Salk inactivated and Sabin oral vaccines have eliminated wild poliovirus from almost the entire world.

name: HIV/AIDS
symptoms: Flu-like fever and rash weeks after exposure
Weight loss and chronic night sweats
Progressive depletion of CD4+ helper T cells
Opportunistic infections like thrush or PCP
fact: HIV uses reverse transcriptase to transcribe its single-stranded RNA genome into double-stranded DNA inside host T cells.

name: Hepatitis B
symptoms: Fatigue, nausea, and loss of appetite
Pain in the upper right abdomen
Dark tea-colored urine and pale stools
fact: The Hepatitis B vaccine was the first vaccine capable of preventing a human cancer (hepatocellular carcinoma).

name: Infectious mononucleosis
fact: Epstein-Barr virus infects B lymphocytes via the CD21 receptor, stimulating reactive 'atypical' T cells.

name: Type 1 diabetes
symptoms: Fruity acetone smell on the breath
Autoimmune loss of pancreatic beta cells
fact: Without insulin, cells cannot take up blood glucose and break down fats into acidic ketone bodies instead.

name: Hypothyroidism
symptoms: Dry skin, brittle hair, and puffy face
Slow heart rate and high TSH hormone
fact: Insufficient thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronine (T3) lowers the basal metabolic rate across all tissues.

name: Graves' disease
fact: Autoantibodies mimic TSH and continuously stimulate the thyroid gland to overproduce thyroid hormones.

name: Iron-deficiency anemia
symptoms: Shortness of breath on climbing stairs
Craving to chew ice or dirt (pica)
fact: Iron is the central atom of the heme group in hemoglobin; without it, red blood cells become small and pale.

name: Sickle cell disease
symptoms: Painful hand and foot swelling in children
Episodes of severe vaso-occlusive bone pain
Crescent-shaped red blood cells from HbS
fact: A single glutamate-to-valine point mutation in beta-globin causes hemoglobin S to polymerize under low oxygen.

name: Cystic fibrosis
symptoms: Poor weight gain despite good appetite
Chronic cough with thick sticky mucus
fact: Mutations in the CFTR chloride channel gene impair water movement across mucus-producing epithelia.

name: Hemophilia
symptoms: Deficiency of clotting factor VIII or IX
fact: Because the factor VIII and IX genes sit on the X chromosome, the disorder predominantly affects males.

name: Asthma
symptoms: Chest tightness and shortness of breath
Dry cough worse at night or in cold air
Triggered by pollen, dust mites, or exercise
fact: Bronchospasm, mucosal swelling, and mucus plugs narrow the bronchioles during an acute flare-up.

name: Appendicitis
symptoms: Loss of appetite and mild nausea
Low-grade fever and white cell spike
Dull pain starting around the belly button
Sharp pain localizing to McBurney's point
fact: Obstruction of the appendiceal lumen leads to bacterial overgrowth, ischemia, and risk of perforation.

name: Gout
symptoms: Joint becomes swollen, red, and hot
Triggered by purine-rich meat or seafood
Chalky nodules (tophi) on ears or fingers
Needle-shaped urate crystals in big toe
fact: Monosodium urate crystals precipitate in cooler peripheral joints like the first metatarsophalangeal joint.

name: Migraine
symptoms: Fatigue and neck stiffness before onset
Extreme sensitivity to light and sound
Zigzag flashing visual aura for 20 minutes
fact: Cortical spreading depression and trigeminal nerve release of CGRP peptide drive the aura and pain phases.

name: Parkinson's disease
symptoms: Reduced facial expression and soft voice
Cogwheel muscle rigidity and stooped posture
Loss of dopamine neurons in substantia nigra
fact: Degeneration of dopaminergic neurons in the midbrain's substantia nigra impairs basal ganglia motor control.

name: Alzheimer's disease
symptoms: Trouble finding words and planning tasks
Amyloid plaques and tau tangles in cortex
fact: Extracellular beta-amyloid plaques and intracellular hyperphosphorylated tau tangles are the pathological hallmarks.

name: Multiple sclerosis
symptoms: Episodes of numbness and tingling in limbs
Painful blurring of vision in one eye
Autoimmune demyelination of CNS white matter
fact: Immune attacks strip myelin sheaths in the brain, optic nerves, and spinal cord, slowing nerve conduction.

name: Lupus
symptoms: Painless mouth ulcers and hair thinning
fact: An autoimmune disease where antinuclear antibodies form immune complexes that deposit in skin, joints, and kidneys.

name: Rheumatoid arthritis
symptoms: Symmetric swelling of wrists and knuckles
fact: Unlike osteoarthritis from wear and tear, immune inflammation of the synovial membrane symmetrically attacks joints.

name: Celiac disease
symptoms: Itchy blisters on elbows and knees
Triggered by eating wheat, barley, or rye
fact: An autoimmune reaction to dietary gluten damages the absorptive villi of the duodenum and jejunum.

name: Scurvy
symptoms: Poor wound healing and easy bruising
Defective collagen from lack of vitamin C
fact: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) is an essential cofactor for prolyl hydroxylase, which cross-links collagen fibers.

name: Rickets
symptoms: Bone pain and muscle weakness in children
Knobby widening of wrists and ribs
Impaired calcium absorption from low sun/diet
Outward bowing of the weight-bearing legs
fact: Without vitamin D, growing epiphyseal plates cannot mineralize properly with calcium and phosphate.

name: Heart attack
symptoms: Sudden shortness of breath and cold sweat
Crushing pressure in the center of chest
Pain radiating to left arm and jaw
Coronary artery blockage with troponin spike
fact: Rupture of an atherosclerotic plaque triggers a thrombus that starves downstream heart muscle of oxygen.

name: Candidiasis
symptoms: White curd-like plaques on oral mucosa
Erythematous base that bleeds if scraped
fact: Candida albicans is a dimorphic fungus capable of shifting between yeast cells and invasive pseudohyphae.

name: Aspergillosis
symptoms: Fungus ball in pre-existing lung cavity
fact: Aspergillus fumigatus produces airborne conidia that germinate into branching septate hyphae in damaged lung tissue.

name: Cryptococcosis
symptoms: Budding yeast with halo on India ink
Exposure to pigeon droppings or soil
fact: Cryptococcus neoformans is protected by a prominent glucuronoxylomannan polysaccharide capsule visible via negative stain.

name: Histoplasmosis
symptoms: Exposure to bat caves or bird guano
fact: Histoplasma capsulatum thrives in soil enriched by bird or bat guano, predominantly in river valley basins.

name: Coccidioidomycosis
symptoms: Tender red skin nodules on shins
Recent dust exposure in arid southwest
fact: Coccidioides arthroconidia become airborne in desert dust and transform into endospore-filled spherules inside lung alveoli.

name: Blastomycosis
symptoms: Osteolytic bone lesions and joint swelling
fact: Blastomyces dermatitidis yeasts exhibit a distinctive thick doubly refractive wall and broad-based budding neck.

name: Pneumocystis Pneumonia
symptoms: Severe hypoxemia out of proportion to signs
Cup-shaped cysts on silver methenamine stain
fact: Formerly considered a protozoan, DNA sequencing proved Pneumocystis is an atypical fungus with cholesterol in its membrane.

name: Tinea Corporis
symptoms: Central clearing forming a ring shape
Contact with infected pet or wrestler
fact: Dermatophyte fungi secrete keratinase enzymes allowing them to feed strictly on dead keratinized tissue like skin and nails.

name: Sporotrichosis
symptoms: Prick from rose thorn or sphagnum
fact: Sporothrix exhibits classic nodular lymphangitis, spreading sequentially along lymphatic channels draining the inoculated limb.

name: Mucormycosis
fact: Mucorales fungi are angioinvasive, invading blood vessel walls to cause extensive ischemic thrombosis and tissue necrosis.

name: Lung Cancer
symptoms: Horner syndrome with ptosis and miosis
fact: Lung malignancies often produce paraneoplastic syndromes like SIADH or hypercalcemia by ectopic hormone secretion.

name: Breast Cancer
symptoms: Dimpled skin like an orange peel
High familial risk linked to BRCA
fact: Peau d'orange skin texture occurs when malignant cells infiltrate and obstruct subdermal lymphatic drainage.

name: Colorectal Cancer
symptoms: Change in bowel habits and caliber
Occult fecal blood and iron deficiency
fact: Most bowel malignancies evolve gradually through an adenoma-to-carcinoma sequence driven by chromosomal instability.

name: Pancreatic Cancer
symptoms: Dark amber urine and pale clay stool
fact: Courvoisier's law states that an enlarged painless gallbladder in a jaundiced patient strongly suggests an obstructive pancreatic head tumor.

name: Prostate Cancer
symptoms: Unremitting lower back and hip pain
fact: Prostate adenocarcinoma metastasizes characteristically to the lumbar spine through Batson's venous plexus.

name: Melanoma
symptoms: Variegated shades of brown and black
Evolution in lesion shape or elevation
fact: Breslow depth measures the vertical tumor thickness in millimeters and represents the single strongest prognostic indicator.

name: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
symptoms: Bone and joint pain in a child
fact: ALL is the most prevalent childhood malignancy, characterized by uncontrolled clonal proliferation of immature lymphoid progenitor cells.

name: Hodgkin Lymphoma
symptoms: Drenching night sweats and weight loss
fact: Reed-Sternberg cells are giant neoplastic B cells that display bilateral mirror-image nuclei with prominent eosinophilic nucleoli.

name: Glioblastoma
fact: Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive grade IV astrocytoma displaying pseudopalisading necrosis and extensive microvascular proliferation.

name: Gastric Cancer
fact: Virchow's node (left supraclavicular enlargement) signifies advanced transperitoneal metastasis of gastric adenocarcinoma.

name: Salmonellosis
symptoms: History of raw eggs or reptile contact
fact: Salmonella utilizes a type III secretion system to inject effector proteins into intestinal enterocytes, triggering inflammatory endocytosis.

name: Pertussis
symptoms: Mild coryza and low fever for two weeks
fact: Pertussis toxin catalyzes ADP-ribosylation of inhibitory G proteins, locking adenylyl cyclase in an active state.

name: Diphtheria
symptoms: Sore throat low fever and hoarseness
fact: Diphtheria exotoxin permanently halts host protein synthesis by ADP-ribosylating elongation factor 2 (EF-2).

name: Ebola Virus Disease
symptoms: Sudden high fever and intense myalgia
Exposure to bats or primates in tropics
fact: Ebolavirus is a filamentous single-stranded negative-sense RNA filovirus that infects monocytes and triggers devastating cytokine release.

name: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease
symptoms: Sharp wave complexes on EEG tracing
fact: CJD is triggered by misfolded prions (PrPSc) that recruit normal alpha-helical prion proteins into insoluble beta-sheet aggregates.

name: Hepatitis A
symptoms: Dark tea-colored urine and pale stool
Ingestion of raw shellfish or water
fact: Unlike Hepatitis B and C, Hepatitis A is an acute self-limiting picornavirus that never progresses to chronic hepatitis or cirrhosis.

name: Hepatitis C
fact: Over seventy percent of acute Hep C infections become chronic due to hypervariable envelope genes that evade neutralizing antibodies.

name: Hepatitis D
symptoms: Clinical worsening of known HBV carrier
Presence of delta antigen with HBsAg
fact: HDV is a defective subviral satellite RNA that cannot replicate or encapsulate without Hepatitis B surface antigens.

name: Hepatitis E
symptoms: Dark amber urine and generalized itch
fact: Infection during the third trimester of pregnancy can lead to fulminant hepatic failure with mortality rates approaching twenty-five percent.

name: Rubella
symptoms: Transient joint aches in young adults
Cataracts and deafness risk in newborn
fact: Congenital rubella syndrome causes the classic triad of sensorineural deafness, cataracts, and cardiac patent ductus arteriosus.

name: Chikungunya
symptoms: High fever and sudden violent chills
fact: The name originates from the Kimakonde language meaning 'to become contorted', describing the patient's hunched arthritic posture.

name: Chlamydia
fact: Chlamydia alternates between infectious metabolically inactive elementary bodies and non-infectious replicating reticulate bodies.

name: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
fact: ALS damages both upper motor neurons in the motor cortex and lower motor neurons in the anterior horn of the spinal cord.

name: Huntington's Disease
fact: Huntington's is caused by an unstable CAG trinucleotide repeat expansion encoding an elongated polyglutamine tract in the huntingtin protein.

name: Crohn's Disease
fact: Crohn's disease features transmural inflammation throughout any part of the gastrointestinal tract, sparing no layer of the bowel wall.

name: Ulcerative Colitis
symptoms: Urgent tenesmus and lower left cramps
Loss of bowel haustra on imaging
fact: Unlike Crohn's, ulcerative colitis is strictly limited to the mucosa and submucosa of the colon and rectum.

name: Pellagra
symptoms: Diet based strictly on untreated maize
fact: Pellagra is classic for the 4 D's: Dermatitis, Diarrhea, Dementia, and Death if left untreated with nicotinamide.

name: Beriberi
symptoms: Loss of ankle reflexes and calf ache
Confusion and ataxia from thiamine drop
fact: Wet beriberi impacts cardiovascular physiology with vasodilation and edema, while dry beriberi manifests as peripheral neuropathy.

name: Hashimoto's Thyroiditis
fact: Hashimoto's thyroiditis is marked histologically by dense lymphocytic infiltration with germinal centers and Hurthle cells.

name: Myasthenia Gravis
symptoms: Difficulty chewing at the end of meals
Marked symptom relief with ice pack
fact: Myasthenia gravis is commonly associated with thymic hyperplasia or thymoma, both involving T-cell dysregulation.
